invention.ref: Masahiro Hara and his team at Denso Wave invent the Quick Response (QR) matrix barcode in Kariya, Japan
invention.ref_zh: 原昌宏带领日本电装（Denso Wave）团队在爱知县刈谷市发明快速响应矩阵式二维码

patent.ref: Japanese patent JP2938338B2 registered; Denso committed to waive patent rights, establishing it as an open standard
patent.ref_zh: 日本专利 JP2938338B2 获得授权；电装宣布免费开放专利使用，确立开放标准

popularization.ref: Approved as international standard ISO/IEC 18004, later surging globally via smartphones and mobile payments
popularization.ref_zh: 获批成为 ISO/IEC 18004 国际标准，后随智能手机与移动支付在全球爆发式普及

locations.place_label_zh: 日本爱知县刈谷市（日本电装 / Denso Wave）

sources.title: History of QR Code — DENSO WAVE
Masahiro Hara, Motoaki Watabe, Tadao Nojiri, Takayuki Nagaya, Yuji Uchiyama (QR code) — European Inventor Award

summary_zh: 1994 年日本电装公司的原昌宏发明三角定位的高密度矩阵式二维码；因电装放弃行使专利费，该技术成为全球开放标准并重塑了移动支付与信息交互。
summary_en: Invented in 1994 by Masahiro Hara at Denso Wave, the 2D QR code enabled omnidirectional high-speed scanning. Denso's waiver of patent fees fostered its global ubiquity in payments and connectivity.

image.alt_zh: 使用智能手机扫描海报上的二维码
image.alt_en: Scanning a QR code on a poster using a smartphone
